name: Obsidian Notes
description: Gives the agents an Obsidian vault as their durable knowledge base and is the authoritative catalog for note structure (templates, frontmatter, wikilinks, and update discipline), with TPM-only writes and a host-side Detect Vault button for setting the vault location.

vaultPath.label: Vault Path
vaultPath.description: Absolute path to the Obsidian vault root. Set it manually or via the Detect Vault button. Empty disables notes and the session continues. A set but unresolvable path is a configuration error: notes are skipped, and a Ticket PR queue aborts.

writeFrontmatter.label: Write Frontmatter
writeFrontmatter.description: When on (default), every notes file opens with a YAML frontmatter block (title, type, dates, tags, per-type fields). Off skips frontmatter; other structure conventions still apply.
